craft_evidence.owned: no claim found (about page and 64 site pages read)
craft_evidence.mills: no: denim and shirting "sourced from Japan", mill not named
craft_evidence.madein: 48/71 own-line clothing listings state where made (Portugal and Peru on knits and tees; denim "Cut and sewn in Los Angeles, CA")
craft_evidence.heritage: none on site: about page is undated and unplaced
craft_evidence.process: partial: denim pages list Japanese denim, cut-and-sew and leather patch in Los Angeles, hardware made in Japan, sanforized right-hand twill
craft_evidence.reasoning: Two thirds of the own-line listings state where they are made, and the denim pages say what is cut and sewn in Los Angeles and what comes from Japan. No maker, mill or facility is named and the brand gives no founding story on its own site.
